articles.title: Why a Chilean salt flat is a microcosm of the extractive frontiers of green capitalism
articles.summary:
In the Atacama desert, the extraction of lithium – so crucial to addressing the climate crisis – comes with escalating social and environmental costs

A high-altitude desert plateau traverses Argentina, Bolivia and Chile. I am on the Chilean side, sitting in a Jeep along with two other researchers. The afternoon air is thin and brisk but the sun is piercing – a combination I am familiar with from years of living and travelling in South America’s Andean range.

The landscape is a study in contrasts and contours: broad basins suddenly cut off by sweeping curves; flat expanses sliced by near vertical ascents. The Licancabur volcano looms large above us. Vegetation and humidity levels change rapidly with the rising altitude, bringing cooler temperatures, wetter air and denser plant life.

Region nadále čelí bezpečnostním výzvám v podobě organizovaného zločinu, nelegální těžby a klimatických extrémů v Chile a Kolumbii.
archive.security_status_en: South America is experiencing heightened political friction as Brazil's presidential race heads to a runoff after a razor-thin first round pitting right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro closely against incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The region also continues to grapple with localized security threats from organized crime, illegal mining networks, and extreme weather events in Chile and Colombia.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se pozornost trhů zaměří na předvolební kampaň před druhým kolem v Brazílii a vývoj kolem nových obvinění vůči venezuelskému vedení. Sledovat se budou také makroekonomická data z Argentiny.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, market focus will center on the campaigning ahead of Brazil's presidential runoff and reactions to the intensified U.S. legal pressure on Venezuela. Argentine macroeconomic releases will also be closely monitored.
